footer.disclaimer: GROLOO hosts no video files and stores no media on its servers. The catalog shows descriptive metadata only; any playable sources come from third-party add-ons you install, and your browser connects to them directly.
legal.title: Legal & Takedown Policy
legal.disclaimer_body: GROLOO is a personal media library and browser. It does not host, store, upload, cache, or proxy any film or series video files, and its servers never transit media. When you play something, your browser connects directly to a source supplied by a third-party add-on that you chose to install. GROLOO does not control, endorse, or take responsibility for those add-ons or the content they make available. Catalog metadata, cover art, and translations shown here are descriptive information only and are not the copyrighted media itself.
legal.privacy_body: GROLOO does not log your IP address or keep server-side request logs. The only data stored against your account is what the service needs to run and sync across your devices — your email, an encrypted password (or your Google sign-in identifier), your watchlist, continue-watching positions, and add-on preferences. We show no ads and run no third-party trackers, and we never sell or share your personal data. A single first-party cookie keeps you signed in. To display catalog metadata and Georgian translations we send the title or search term you request to our providers (TMDB and Google Translate) — never your identity. Your installed add-ons are contacted directly by your browser, not by our servers, so we never see what you stream. You can delete your account at any time to remove your data, or contact privacy@groloo.com to exercise any privacy right.
legal.takedown_body: If you are a copyright owner (or an agent authorised to act on their behalf) and believe that an add-on surfaced through GROLOO points to material that infringes your rights, we will act on a valid notice and promptly remove the relevant add-on or reference from GROLOO.
legal.takedown_list_intro: To help us act quickly, please include the following in your notice:
legal.takedown_l1: Identification of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed.
legal.takedown_l2: The exact link or page on GROLOO that points to the material.
legal.takedown_l3: Your contact details (name, organisation, email, and physical address).
legal.takedown_l4: A statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is not authorised by the rights owner, its agent, or the law.
legal.takedown_l5: A statement that the information in your notice is accurate, and that you are the rights owner or are authorised to act on their behalf.
legal.takedown_note: Because GROLOO does not host the underlying files, removing a link from our index does not delete the file from the third-party service. To have the file itself removed, the notice must also be sent to the service that actually hosts it.
legal.contact_body: For copyright and DMCA takedown notices, write to our designated agent:
legal.contact_privacy: For privacy and data-protection requests — including access, correction and deletion — write to:
legal.contact_note: We aim to review valid notices within a few business days.

addon.upcoming.desc: Adds the "Upcoming Movies & Series" marquee on the home screen — the 10 most-anticipated unreleased titles with posters, ratings and trailers. Self-refreshing: once a title is released it drops out and the next most-wanted takes its slot.
addon.studios.desc: Adds the "Studios" row on the home screen — a rail of major studio logos (Marvel, Pixar, Warner Bros., Disney and more). Tap a logo to browse that studio's full catalogue. Removing it hides the row.
addon.catalog.desc: Adds the Trending & Top-Rated rows on the home screen — Trending Movies, Trending Shows, Top Rated Movies, Top Rated Shows, Trending Anime and Top Rated Anime. Use Configure to check which rows appear; removing the add-on hides them all.

legal.privacy_delete: To delete your account, open Settings → Account & legal and choose “Delete account”. Deletion is immediate and permanent: it removes your profile, your saved list, your watch history and positions, and your installed add-on collection from our servers.
legal.attrib_body: Catalog metadata, artwork, and streaming-availability data are supplied by third parties whose terms require us to credit them, and part of the app is open-source software carried under its own licence.
attrib.title: Attributions & Licences
attrib.intro: GROLOO is assembled from data and code published by other people. The notices boxed below are the conditions we display them under, and are reproduced in English exactly as worded — they are not translated, because a reworded notice is no longer the notice.
attrib.tmdb_body: Titles, synopses, cast and crew, ratings, posters, and backdrops come from The Movie Database. TMDB does not operate GROLOO, has no involvement in which add-ons you install, and has no connection to anything those add-ons make available.
attrib.jw_body: The “watch on” services listed against a title come from TMDB’s watch-provider data, which is sourced from JustWatch. Availability is per-country and changes without notice; GROLOO neither verifies nor resells any subscription, and links out to the service itself.
attrib.heart_body: The catalog and library engine that runs inside your browser is Groloo Heart, released under the MIT licence. Its full notice is reproduced below.
attrib.addons_body: Community add-ons are written, published, and licensed by their own authors. They are neither developed nor endorsed by GROLOO, and each one carries whatever licence and terms its author chose — see the add-on itself for those.

settings.account_desc: Credits, licences, and removing your account
settings.delete_what: Deleting your account is immediate and cannot be undone. It removes your profile, your saved list, your watch history and playback positions, and your installed add-on collection from our servers. Playback preferences held only in this browser stay until you clear it.
settings.delete_err: Could not delete your account. Please try again.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your GROLOO account
deleteAccount.lede: This page deletes a GROLOO account and everything stored against it. You do not need the app installed to use it — signing in here is enough.
deleteAccount.what: Deleting removes your account record — your email address, your password, and any linked Google sign-in — along with your saved list, your watch history and playback positions, your installed add-on collection, and every session signed in to the account. Nothing is kept in a recoverable form and nothing is held back for reactivation.
deleteAccount.what_local: Preferences that never left your device — playback settings, subtitle styling, and your chosen language — are stored in your browser or TV app, not on our servers. Deletion does not reach them; clear the app or site data to remove those too.
deleteAccount.irreversible: This cannot be undone. There is no grace period, no archive, and no way for us to restore an account afterwards — to use GROLOO again you would have to create a new one.
deleteAccount.signin_prompt: Only the account holder can delete an account, so sign in with the account you want removed. Signing in does nothing on its own — you still have to confirm on the next step.
deleteAccount.done_body: Your profile, your list, your history, and your add-ons are gone from our servers, and every device signed in to that account has been signed out. There is nothing left to do.
addons.unlinked_head: Needs its link on this device
addons.unlinked_why: Your add-ons and their install links travel with your account, so a new device picks them up ready to use. These few are older than that: they were saved when your account kept the source but not the link, and the link they were installed with only ever existed on that device. They are still yours and still on your account. Paste each one here once and it syncs from then on, everywhere you sign in.

addons.relink_prompt: Pasting the install link for {name}. Use the same link you installed it with — for this add-on, the copy on your other device is the only one there is. Once it is here it syncs with your account.
